note: P4397 (Pro 31:25) — strength and dignity are her clothing, and she laughs at the time to come.

dims.v: inner strength — the settled strength she wears like a garment

the strength that clothes the excellent wife — an inner fortitude and capability worn like a garment, settled and habitual, so that she is arrayed in strength and can laugh, unafraid, at the days to come
the dignity it is paired with (267415)
welded to the dignity that clothes her with it

oz (strength) — 'STRENGTH and dignity are her clothing, and she laughs at the time to come' (31:25); her strength is not occasional but habitual, worn like a robe. Clothed in strength, she meets the future with serene, fearless confidence (cf 31:21).
dignity — the honour and poise that adorn her

the dignity that, with strength, clothes the excellent wife — the honour, poise, and self-possessed gravity that adorn her character, a bearing that commands respect and rests secure about what is to come
the strength it is paired with (267414)
welded to the strength that clothes her with it

hadar (dignity/splendour) — 'strength and DIGNITY are her clothing'; dignity adorns her like a robe — the honourable poise of a settled, capable character. She wears her worth, and laughs, secure, at the future.
